text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder has invited me to visit an exhibition on Umamusume history together.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So this is how passion for racing gets passed down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The walls are lined with a plethora of items, from photos of past races to the cleats legendary Umamusume wore early in their careers. Even letters to their trainers are on display.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Lessons of the past lead us to new discoveries. That rings so true as I walk through these halls.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The passion and grit from these runners come across loud and clear from within each display.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I must do all of them proud.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a fellow Umamusume who carries on their legacy, Grass Wonder seems to enjoy exploring this display of past racers' experiences.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: This one's face is cute, but she ain't exactly got curves. I've seen better. Fifty-seven points!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text: Pretty generous if you ask me. Look how desperate she looks racing in this photo. Forty-three points, tops!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh… It seems some people just can't keep their voices down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two offenders receive many unpleasant glances from the other visitors, but they seem unwilling to turn it down a notch.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll be right back.
choice_data_list: Be careful not to provoke them, okay?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you for your concern.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But there are lines that should never be crossed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder briskly walks up to the men and taps them on their shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Might I ask what the two of you have come here to do?

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If that is the only manner of evaluation you care to give these runners, then perhaps this isn't the right place for you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You're disturbing those of us who came here to enjoy history. So would you please see yourselves out the door… And I mean now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her cold and straightforward tone must have terrified the two men, because they both rush out the door in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Perhaps that was… excessive of me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But I simply couldn't allow them to continue like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She smiles softly, but I can tell that behind her gentle demeanor there lies a strong sense of conviction.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She approaches the men and says, "May I have a word?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Your loud and rude remarks are disturbing the guests and staff.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Personally, I don't think that kind of talk is appropriate for this establishment. Am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a stern talking-to, the men must have noticed all the other onlookers, because they awkwardly begin making for the exit.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I don't like to judge others for their personal tastes, but…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I just couldn't let their utter disrespect for history slide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Behind Grass Wonder's rueful smile, I can see she harbors a powerful respect for her Umamusume forebears.
